main_measure.name: slope of 10-day excess return (over coin drift) on forecast, pooled non-overlapping grid
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope t >= 2 with top-fifth difference > 0; reject: slope t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean excess return of top fifth of positive-forecast cases minus rest of positive-forecast cases

decided_by: Slope t is 2 or more and the top-fifth minus rest difference is above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: Drift is each coin's mean 10-bar return over its grid cases in all windows, the slope comes from an OLS with intercept on all grid cases, and the top fifth is the round(n/5) highest-forecast positive cases (ties kept in time order).
